Parameters (inout) None 5 33 of 53 Document ID 1018: AUTOSAR_SWS_MemoryDriver Specification of Memory Driver AUTOSAR CP R21-11 4 Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: The requested job has been accepted by the module. E_NOT_OK: The requested job has not been accepted by the module. E_MEM_SERVICE_NOT_AVAIL: The service function is not implemented. Description Triggers a write job to store the passed data to the provided address area with given address and length. The result of this service can be retrieved using the Mem_GetJobResult API. If the write operation was successful, the job result is MEM_JOB_OK. If there was an issue writing the data, the result is MEM_FAILED. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via Mem.h
